title: FaceRiff: Data-Efficient Unified Text-to-3D Face Asset Synthesis via Geometric Conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2611.21867v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-resolution facial datasets with consistent UV-mapped geometry, albedo, and physically based displacement are scarce, yet such assets are essential for photorealistic digital-human rendering. Existing 3D face generation methods are often slow, single-modality, or require large specialized datasets. Meanwhile, large image diffusion models encode strong facial priors but do not natively produce lighting-independent textures, pore-scale displacement, or UV-aligned geometry. We present FaceRiff, a unified, data- and parameter-efficient framework for generating complete 3D face assets (mesh, albedo, and displacement) directly from text in a shared UV space. FaceRiff adapts a pretrained SDXL backbone with task-specific LoRA adapters and uses UV normal maps as geometric conditioning: per-instance normals guide albedo and displacement synthesis, while a dataset-mean normal provides a canonical spatial anchor for mesh generation. translated_title: FaceRiff：基于几何条件的高效数据统一文本到3D人脸资产生成框架
translated_abstract: 具有一致的UV映射几何、反照率和基于物理的置换贴图的高分辨率人脸数据集十分稀缺，然而这类资产对于照片级真实感的数字人渲染至关重要。现有的3D人脸生成方法通常速度慢、局限于单一模态，或需要大规模的专门数据集。与此同时，大型图像扩散模型编码了强大的人脸先验，但其本身无法原生生成与光照无关的纹理、毛孔级置换贴图或UV对齐的几何结构。我们提出了FaceRiff，这是一个统一且数据与参数高效的框架，能够在共享UV空间中直接从文本生成完整的3D人脸资产（网格、反照率和置换贴图）。FaceRiff通过任务特定的LoRA适配器对预训练的SDXL主干网络进行适配，并使用UV法线图作为几何条件：每个实例的法线图引导反照率和置换贴图的合成，而数据集平均法线则为网格生成提供规范的空间锚点。仅使用……
tldr: FaceRiff提出了一种数据与参数高效的统一文本到3D人脸资产生成框架，通过在预训练SDXL上添加任务特定LoRA适配器，并以UV法线图作为几何条件，在共享UV空间中直接从文本生成包含网格、反照率和置换贴图的完整3D人脸资产。
en_tdlr: FaceRiff is a data- and parameter-efficient unified framework that generates complete 3D face assets (mesh, albedo, and displacement) directly from text in a shared UV space by adapting a pretrained SDXL backbone with task-specific LoRA adapters and using UV normal maps as geometric conditioning.
